title.zh-TW: 用 gh 直接安裝與啟動 Copilot CLI
title.en: Install and launch Copilot CLI directly through gh

body.zh-TW: 現在你想在終端機使用 Copilot CLI（讓你透過文字指令使用 Copilot 的工具）時，可以直接輸入 `gh copilot`；電腦尚未安裝它就會先詢問你是否安裝，裝好後接著啟動。若你已經知道要交代什麼，也能在後面接上參數與旗標，`gh` 會原封不動轉交給 Copilot CLI 執行。這不是讓 Copilot 多了新本事，而是把原本要另外找安裝程式、再切換指令的兩段路接起來，像在車站同一個窗口買票後直接上車。
body.en: You can now get to Copilot CLI from the same terminal workflow you use for GitHub. Run `gh copilot` and gh will offer to install Copilot CLI if it is missing, then launch it. Add arguments or flags after the command and gh passes them through to Copilot CLI unchanged. Copilot has not gained a new capability here; the update simply joins installation and launch into one route instead of making you find a separate installer and switch commands, like buying a ticket and boarding at the same station counter.

title.zh-TW: 可清除特定分支的全部快取，建立重複 PR 會即時擋下
title.en: Clear every cache for a ref and catch duplicate PR targets early

body.zh-TW: 現在你要清理某個 ref（Git 用來指向分支或版本的名稱）留下的快取（把先前結果暫存、下次直接使用的資料）時，`gh cache delete` 可以一次刪掉該 ref 的所有快取，不必逐筆處理。建立 Pull Request（PR，把程式修改送人審核的請求）時，如果 head 與 base ref 相同，`gh pr create` 也會直接報錯；同一個起點與目標沒有可合併的差異，早點停下比建立後才發現更省事。貢獻指南同時改得更清楚，並記錄了兩位首次貢獻者。像整理倉庫時按區清空舊紙箱，門口也先攔住要把同一份文件送給自己的表單。
body.en: You can now clear all cached results attached to one ref—a Git name that points to a branch or version—with a single `gh cache delete` action instead of removing them one by one. `gh pr create` also now errors when its head and base refs are identical, because there is nothing to merge between the same starting point and destination. The contributor guide was clarified, and the release records two first-time contributors. It is like emptying every old box in one warehouse aisle while a guard stops a form addressed from you to you before it reaches the desk.

title.zh-TW: 瀏覽網頁時可直接切到 Actions
title.en: Browse straight to Actions

body.zh-TW: 想從終端機直接看 GitHub Actions（自動執行測試、建置或部署工作的服務），現在 gh browse 多了一個 --actions 旗標（flag，附在指令後改變行為的選項）。它讓瀏覽指令能指定開啟 Actions 頁面，不必先進專案首頁再手動切換分頁。公告只說新增這個旗標，沒有承諾改變工作流程的內容或結果。就像電梯多了一顆直達地下停車場的按鈕：目的地沒變，只是少按幾次樓層鍵。
body.en: When you want to inspect GitHub Actions—the service that runs automated tests, builds, or deployments—from the terminal, gh browse now has an --actions flag. A flag is an option added to a command to change what it opens, and this one sends the browse command to the Actions page instead of making you start on a repository page and switch tabs. The notes only add this shortcut; they do not claim to change what workflows do or produce. Like adding a direct elevator button for the parking garage: same destination, fewer buttons.

items.original: Add gh browse --actions flag by @rneatherway in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/12091

title.zh-TW: 可用 Git remote 名稱指定預設專案
title.en: Use a Git remote name to choose the default repository

body.zh-TW: 你設定 gh repo set-default 的預設專案時，現在可以使用 Git remote（遠端連線名稱，例如 origin）名稱來指定。這讓已經替同一份程式碼設好多個遠端位置的人，可以沿用自己看得懂的名稱來選擇預設目標；公告沒有說會自動替你新增或改寫 remote。就像寄件簿裡已有「公司」和「個人」兩個收件人標籤，現在可直接挑標籤，不必再重抄完整地址。
body.en: When setting the default repository with gh repo set-default, you can now name a Git remote, such as origin. That helps people who already gave one codebase several remote destinations choose the default by the label they recognize. The notes do not say the command will create or rewrite any remotes for you. It is like choosing an existing “work” or “personal” label in an address book instead of copying the full address again.

title.zh-TW: 專案資料異常不再讓工具直接中斷
title.en: Unexpected project data no longer makes the tool stop abruptly

body.zh-TW: 你處理 GitHub 專案資料時，遇到 null project items（空值的專案項目，代表資料位置存在但沒有可讀內容）不會再觸發 panic（程式無法自行處理錯誤而突然中止）。這是既有處理流程的修復，不是新增專案管理功能。同一版也修正安裝指南裡 Debian CLI 套件連結，讓讀者前往正確位置。就像清單裡有一格空白時，工作人員會跳過那格繼續辦事，而入口指示牌也改成正確方向。
body.en: When working with GitHub project data, null project items—places where an item exists but has no readable value—will no longer trigger a panic, an abrupt program stop when it cannot handle an error. This is a repair to an existing path, not a new project-management feature. The same release also corrected the Debian CLI package link in the installation guide, sending readers to the right place. Like a clerk skipping a blank box on a form and continuing, while the sign at the entrance is pointed the right way.

title.zh-TW: 發行流程與底層相依套件完成維護
title.en: Release tooling and underlying dependencies received maintenance

body.zh-TW: 一般使用者不需要調整任何指令，但這版更新了 OAuth、簽章、建置驗證與多個 Go 相依套件，並整理 CI（持續整合，自動檢查與打包程式的流程）的發行工作：升級 GoReleaser、更新 Azure Code Signing、替各建置工作加標籤、啟用 noop linter（不執行檢查工作的檢查器），以及補上 Windows 建立暫存標籤時的 shell 指定。擴充功能工作流程範本也更新 actions/checkout。公告沒有宣稱新增終端機功能，因此可把它看成讓出貨工廠持續換好零件的維護。就像倉庫更新封條機、分揀規則與零件，寄出的包裹類型不變，但流程有人持續照料。
body.en: You do not need to change any everyday command, but this release updated OAuth, signing, build verification, and several Go dependencies. It also maintained CI, the automated checking and packaging process: GoReleaser was upgraded, Azure Code Signing details changed, build jobs gained tags, and Windows temporary-tag creation received an explicit shell. Extension workflow templates also update actions/checkout. The notes do not claim a new terminal feature, so this is best read as ongoing care for the release factory. Like maintaining a warehouse’s sealers, sorting rules, and spare parts while the kinds of parcels it sends remain the same.

title.zh-TW: 搜尋字詞不再和背景條件混在一起
title.en: Search terms no longer get mixed with background qualifiers

body.zh-TW: 你輸入的搜尋字詞現在會和工具另外加上的背景條件分開處理，不必擔心兩者被混成一句而改變原本想找的內容。這項調整針對使用者自己提供的 search query（搜尋條件，告訴工具要找什麼的文字）與 contextual qualifiers（背景限定條件）之間的界線；公告沒有改動其他搜尋功能。就像你交代圖書館員「找食譜」，再補一句「限館內藏書」：兩張便條各自清楚，才不會把限制誤當成書名的一部分。
body.en: Your search words are now kept separate from the contextual qualifiers the tool adds around them, so those two pieces are less likely to be treated as one muddled request. This change specifically isolates a user-provided search query from its background qualifiers; the release notes do not claim any other search behavior changed. It is like giving a librarian one note saying “cookbooks” and another saying “in this branch only,” instead of accidentally making the restriction part of the title.

items.original: Isolate user-provided search query from contextual qualifiers by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/12170

title.zh-TW: 安裝資訊與授權檢查更明確
title.en: Installation information and license checks are clearer

body.zh-TW: 想找安裝來源或協助打包的人，現在能看到 Debian 與 Ubuntu 被列入非官方套件來源；這是資訊補充，不代表官方提供了新的套件。開發或發行時，若 go-licenses（檢查程式相依套件授權的工具）不在 PATH（終端機用來尋找可執行工具的路徑清單）裡，流程會直接報錯，而不是悄悄帶過。公告也加入 PGP key rotation 的概念驗證，用來測試更新簽章金鑰的輪替。就像工具箱少了必需扳手會立刻亮紅燈，門口也多貼了一張可參考的店家清單。
body.en: People looking for installation sources can now see Debian and Ubuntu listed among unofficial packages; that is an information update, not a claim that new official packages were released. For development or releases, the process now errors when go-licenses, a license-checking tool, is absent from PATH, the list of places a terminal searches for runnable tools. The notes also add a proof of concept for PGP key rotation, testing how signing keys can be changed. Like a toolbox that immediately flags a missing wrench, while the door gains a useful directory of nearby shops.

title.zh-TW: 內部程式與相依套件完成例行整理
title.en: Internal code and dependencies received routine maintenance

body.zh-TW: 日常使用不需要改指令，但這版整理了 GitHub API 用戶端的設定處理、移除了說明用法裡多餘的旗標預設值，並以 Go 標準函式庫取代 multierror。也更新 Go 1.25.4、1.25.5、dev-tunnels SDK，以及加密、protobuf、gRPC、終端介面等相依套件；這些都是程式底層借來運作的零件。兩位貢獻者也在這批變更中首次參與。公告沒有宣稱這些更新帶來特定新功能，所以最準確的理解是維護與相容性整理。就像保養車子時換好零件、整理線路，不必改變方向盤，車仍照原本方式開。
body.en: You do not need to change your everyday commands, but this release tidied configuration handling in a GitHub API client, removed an extra flag default from help usage, and replaced multierror with Go’s standard library. It also updated Go 1.25.4 and 1.25.5, the dev-tunnels SDK, and dependencies for cryptography, protobuf, gRPC, and terminal interfaces—the components the program relies on underneath. Two contributors made their first contributions in this batch. The notes do not promise a specific new feature from these changes, so routine maintenance and compatibility work is the accurate reading. Like servicing a car’s parts and wiring without changing the steering wheel.

title.zh-TW: PR 移除審查者不再失敗，編輯更新傳送清楚
title.en: PR reviewer removal succeeds reliably with clearer API signals

body.zh-TW: 你用 `gh pr edit` 編輯 Pull Request（程式審核單）並移除所有審查者（reviewer，幫你審程式的人）時，現在會在 PR API 呼叫中傳送審查者的空陣列，確保名單能正確清空。空陣列（一個沒有項目的清單）明確表達「不需要任何審查者」。就像在清單上直接填寫「不需要任何審查者」，負責人就知道名單該是空白。
body.en: When you use `gh pr edit` to remove all reviewers from a Pull Request, it now sends an empty reviewer array in PR API calls so the list is handled correctly. An empty array clearly records that no reviewers are wanted. It is like writing "no reviewers needed" directly on a list.

items.original: `gh pr edit`: Ensure empty arrays for reviewers in PR API calls by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/12122

title.zh-TW: 內部開發流程升級，授權檢查回歸、工具版本更新
title.en: License checks restored to workflow, development toolchain upgraded

body.zh-TW: 這版本主要是開發工具與流程的內部改進。首先，原本獨立的授權檢查（license check，確保程式碼裡用的開源套件不違法）被重新整合到主要的程式碼檢查流程（lint workflow）裡面。其次，第三方授權、第三方套件與相依的軟體工具也跟著更新，包括 golangci-lint 的 GitHub Action（在 GitHub 上自動跑程式碼檢查的動作元件）從 8.0.0 升到 9.0.0。這些改動都在開發流程裡，就像汽車廠替檢修廠更新工具，改的是車間裡的設備。
body.en: This release focuses on under-the-hood improvements to the development workflow and toolchain. License checks (verifying that all open-source components used in the code comply with legal requirements) have been integrated back into the main linting workflow. Third-party licenses and dependencies were also updated, and the golangci-lint GitHub Action (a component that runs the code checks automatically on GitHub) was upgraded from 8.0.0 to 9.0.0. Like a repair shop updating its equipment, the changes are in the workshop.

title.zh-TW: 發行版本清單可辨認不可變版本
title.en: Release lists can identify immutable releases

body.zh-TW: 現在你用 `gh release list` 取得 JSON（方便其他程式讀取的固定格式資料）時，會多看到 `isImmutable` 欄位。它會標示這個發行版本是否不可變，也就是發出去後不該再被修改。若你用指令自動檢查版本或串接部署流程，就能先辨認哪些版本要當成定稿處理，少把仍可變動的版本和正式封存版混在一起。這像圖書館替每本書標上「可借閱」或「館藏定本」，一眼就知道哪本不能隨意改頁。
body.en: When you use `gh release list` to get JSON, a structured format other programs can read, you now get an `isImmutable` field. It marks whether a release is immutable, meaning it should not be changed after publication. If you automate release checks or deployment workflows, you can distinguish a final archived release from one that may still change. It is like a library label showing which copy is the unalterable reference edition.

items.original: Add `isImmutable` to `release list` JSON output by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/12064

title.zh-TW: 建立代理任務時可指定自訂代理
title.en: Create agent tasks with a chosen custom agent

body.zh-TW: 現在建立代理任務時，可以在 `gh agent-task create` 加上 `--custom-agent` 或 `-a`，指定要交給哪個自訂代理（替你執行特定工作的自動助手）。以前建立任務時不能在這一步選它；現在你可直接把適合的代理派去做對的工作，少一道建立後再調整的手續。這像寄件時就把信投進正確的專用信箱，不必先送到總收發室再轉寄。
body.en: When creating an agent task, you can now add `--custom-agent` or `-a` to `gh agent-task create` and choose a custom agent, an automated helper for a particular kind of work. You no longer need to create the task first and adjust its assignee afterward. It is like dropping a letter straight into the right specialist mailbox instead of routing it through a central mailroom.

items.original: `gh agent-task create`: support `--custom-agent`/`-a` flag by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/12068

title.zh-TW: 刪除倉庫前多一層提醒，也可還原 PR
title.en: Get a deletion warning and revert a pull request

body.zh-TW: 現在你執行 `gh repo delete --yes` 卻沒有指定倉庫時，指令會提醒 `--yes` 被忽略，而不是讓你以為已略過確認。另新增 `gh pr revert`，可替一個 pull request（PR，把程式修改送來審查與合併的提案）建立反轉那次修改的操作。前者讓刪除前的判斷更清楚，後者讓已合併的改動有一條回頭路。這像拆房前先確認地址，裝錯零件後也能照說明把它換回來。
body.en: If you run `gh repo delete --yes` without naming a repository, the command now warns that `--yes` is being ignored instead of making you think confirmation was skipped. A new `gh pr revert` command can also reverse the changes from a pull request, a proposal to review and merge code changes. One makes deletion intent clearer; the other gives merged work a route back. It is like checking the address before demolition and having instructions to undo a wrongly fitted part.

title.zh-TW: 大型 Gist 檔案可正常查看與編輯
title.en: Large Gist files can be viewed and edited

body.zh-TW: 現在較大的 Gist（GitHub 上用來分享程式片段或文字檔的小型貼文）檔案，也能用指令查看與編輯。這是修復既有功能，不是新增另一種檔案服務；重點是原本因檔案較大而卡住的讀取與修改流程恢復可用。若你把長設定檔、記錄或程式碼放在 Gist，就不用為了大小另找工具處理。這像原本塞不進影印機的大張圖紙，現在能攤平後正常閱讀與修改。
body.en: You can now view and edit larger Gist files, the small GitHub posts used to share code snippets or text files, from the CLI. This repairs existing behavior rather than adding a new file service: reads and edits that failed because a file was large now work again. If you keep a long configuration file, log, or code sample in a Gist, you need not switch tools just because of its size. It is like finally being able to lay a large sheet flat in the copier and work on it.

items.original: fix(gist): add support for editing & viewing large files  by @luxass in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/11761

title.zh-TW: 驗證發行證明遇到 Sigstore 暫時不可用仍可運作
title.en: Release-attestation checks keep working when Sigstore is unavailable

body.zh-TW: 現在 `gh attestation verify` 驗證發行版本的 attestation（用來證明檔案來源與建立過程的簽署證明）時，即使 Sigstore 的 Public Good Instance 暫時無法使用，也能正常運作。指令同時改用 `release` 作為發行版本驗證的固定識別值。這是讓既有驗證流程在外部驗證服務短暫不可用時更可靠，不代表跳過驗證。這像查驗包裹封條時，主要櫃台暫時關閉，仍有正確的查驗方式可接手。
body.en: When `gh attestation verify` checks a release attestation, a signed record that proves a file's origin and build process, it can now keep working if Sigstore's Public Good Instance is temporarily unavailable. The command also uses `release` as the sentinel value for release-attestation verification. This makes the existing verification path more resilient when an outside service is unavailable; it does not mean skipping verification. It is like having a valid backup inspection desk when the main parcel-seal counter is briefly closed.

items.original:
Fix gh attestation verify to work when Public Good Instance of Sigstore is unavailable by @Copilot in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/11989
Use "release" sentinel value for release attestation verification by @Copilot in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/11991

title.zh-TW: 說明文件更準確，內部檢查與相依套件更新
title.en: Documentation is clearer and internal checks and dependencies are updated

body.zh-TW: 現在 `run list`、`release create`、`api`、`gh pr checks`、Linux Homebrew 與 `gh issue develop` 的說明更清楚或修正了錯字，讓你較容易找到 PR 檢查、輸入欄位與輪詢間隔等用法。底層也新增基本 lint（自動檢查程式問題的工具）、調整漏洞掃描與格式檢查，移除過時的 Go 建置標記，並更新 Go、檢查工具與多個相依套件。這些多屬內部維護，未宣稱改變指令功能；它們讓說明與開發防線同步整理。這像把使用手冊校正、保養工具箱並換掉舊零件，日常操作更少踩到小坑。
body.en: Documentation for `run list`, `release create`, `api`, `gh pr checks`, Linux Homebrew, and `gh issue develop` is clearer or has typo fixes, making PR checks, input fields, and polling intervals easier to find. Under the hood, basic linters, tools that automatically spot code problems, were added; vulnerability and formatting checks were adjusted; obsolete Go build tags were removed; and Go, checking tools, and several dependencies were updated. These are mostly maintenance changes, not claimed new command behavior. It is like correcting the manual, servicing the toolbox, and replacing worn parts before they cause small daily snags.

title.zh-TW: 不支援的 GitHub 主機也能順利修改拉取請求
title.en: Edit pull requests without fetching unsupported V1 projects

body.zh-TW: 你在不支援 V1 projects（第一代專案功能）的 GitHub 主機上使用 `gh pr edit` 修改拉取請求時，gh CLI 不會再先嘗試抓取這些主機不支援的專案資料，因此編輯動作能順利進行。它處理的是主機能力不同造成的多餘請求，不是替主機新增 V1 projects。就像在分店修改訂單，分店沒有某種舊型櫃位時，店員會直接替你處理訂單，不再先跑去找那個櫃位。
body.en: When you use `gh pr edit` to edit a pull request on a GitHub host that does not support V1 projects, gh CLI no longer tries to fetch those unsupported project records first. The edit can proceed without that unnecessary request. This handles the host's existing capability difference; it does not add V1 projects to the host. It's like changing an order at a branch that has no old service counter: the clerk handles the order directly instead of sending you to look for a counter that is not there.

items.original: fix `gh pr edit`: do not fetch V1 projects on unsupported GitHub hosts by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/11987

title.zh-TW: `gh pr edit` 指定審核者，不用每次都先抓一輪組織團隊名單
title.en: `gh pr edit` no longer fetches your org's whole team list just to add a reviewer

body.zh-TW: 你用 `gh pr edit` 幫一份 PR（pull request，你送出等人審核、準備合併的一份程式碼修改）指定審核者，如果只是加某個人，不是加某個團隊，以前這個指令還是會先跑去組織裡把整份團隊名單抓一遍，不管你用不用得到。⟦就像去檔案庫辦事，只有真的要用到某份檔案才去調閱它，不會每次進門都先把整個檔案庫翻一遍。⟧現在 `gh pr edit` 只有你真的要指定某個團隊當審核者時，才會去抓這份名單，其餘情況直接跳過這一步。對你來說，差別在於單純加個人當審核者的操作，不會再被一趟用不到的名單查詢拖慢。
body.en: You use `gh pr edit` to set reviewers on a PR — a pull request, the code change you've submitted and are waiting on someone to review before it merges. Add just one person, not a team, and until now the command would still go fetch your entire org's team list first, whether you needed it or not. ⟦It's like visiting an archive: you only pull a specific record when you actually need it, you don't flip through the whole archive every time you walk in the door.⟧ Now `gh pr edit` only fetches that list when you're actually naming a team as a reviewer, and skips the step the rest of the time. For you, that means adding a single person as a reviewer no longer gets slowed down by a team lookup you never needed.

items.original: `gh pr edit`: Only fetch org teams for reviewers when required by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/11835

title.zh-TW: 快取筆數、轉圈指示器、派工倉庫、登入通道，四處小毛病一次修好
title.en: Cache delete counts, the spinner, task-dispatch repo, and login — four small fixes at once

body.zh-TW: 這幾個小毛病都出在不會特別留意的地方。清快取（cache，算過的結果先存著、下次直接拿）時，`gh cache delete` 回報的刪除筆數以前會算錯。不管你只給 key，還是 key 再加上 ref（git 參照，標出這份快取屬於哪個分支），現在數字都對得上。`gh agent-task create` 加 `--follow` 看進度，以前跑完那個轉圈指示器不會自己停，現在結束就跟著收掉。同樣是這個指令，以前派工可能送到上游倉庫（upstream repo，你這份倉庫的來源），而不是你設定的預設倉庫，現在會送對。另外，`auth login` 與 `auth refresh` 改走 UNIX socket（同一台電腦裡程式互傳資料的通道，不繞網路）。⟦像搬完家才發現的幾件小事：箱數少算了、玄關燈忘了關、一封信還寄到舊地址、電話線也沒接上新插孔，這次一併收拾。⟧
body.en: These are the kind of small bugs you'd never notice unless you hit them directly. When you clear the cache — results stored earlier so you don't have to recompute them — `gh cache delete` used to report the wrong number of deleted entries; now the count is right whether you pass just a key or a key plus a ref, the git reference marking which branch a cache entry belongs to. Run `gh agent-task create` with `--follow` to watch progress, and the spinner used to keep spinning after the run finished; now it stops right when the task does. That same command used to sometimes dispatch work to the upstream repo — the repo yours was forked from — instead of your configured default repo; now it goes to the right one. And `auth login` and `auth refresh` now talk over a UNIX socket instead of the network. ⟦It's like the handful of things you only notice after you've finished moving house: you miscounted the boxes, forgot to turn off the hallway light, a letter still went to the old address, and the phone line never got hooked up to the new jack — this round cleans up all four.⟧

items.original:
fix(cache delete): report correct deleted count for key and key+ref deletions by @luxass in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/11838
`gh agent-task create`: Fix `--follow` not killing the progress indicator by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/11879
`gh agent-task create`: Fix targetting upstream instead of default repo by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/11896
Fix `auth login` and `auth refresh` to use UNIX socket by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/11922

title.zh-TW: gh 新增 release verify 指令，確認發行版沒被人動過手腳
title.en: gh adds a release verify command so you can confirm a release hasn't been tampered with

body.zh-TW: 你打包版本發布給同事下載，或反過來下載別人放上去的檔案，想確認沒被偷換——這正是 gh 新增的 `release verify` 與 `release verify-asset` 要處理的事。每個發行版能附上一份 attestation（證明文件，帶簽章與時間戳，把版本、git 標籤與檔案綁在一起）。⟦就像精品出廠附的保證書印著編號跟日期，對得起來才確定是真品，沒被掉包。⟧驗證最新的發行版，打 `gh release verify`；驗證特定版本，加上標籤打 `gh release verify v1.2.3`。手上某個附件檔案，想對到最新發行版，打 `gh release verify-asset my-asset.zip`；要對到特定版本，標籤也加進去，打 `gh release verify-asset v1.2.3 my-asset.zip`。
body.en: You've packaged a release for coworkers to download, or you're the one downloading something someone else uploaded, and you want to be sure it wasn't swapped for something else — that's what gh's new `release verify` and `release verify-asset` handle. Every release can carry an attestation, a signed, timestamped document that ties the release to its version, its git tag, and its files. ⟦It's like a luxury item's warranty card printed with a serial number and a date — if they match, you know it's the real thing and nothing's been switched.⟧ To verify the latest release, run `gh release verify`; to verify a specific one, add the tag: `gh release verify v1.2.3`. Got an asset file you want to match against the latest release? Run `gh release verify-asset my-asset.zip`; to match it against a specific release, add the tag too: `gh release verify-asset v1.2.3 my-asset.zip`.

items.original:
Verify the latest release has a valid attestation: `gh release verify`
Verify a specific release by tag: `gh release verify v1.2.3`
Verify an asset from the latest release: `gh release verify-asset my-asset.zip`
Verify a local asset file originated from a specific release: `gh release verify-asset v1.2.3 my-asset.zip`

title.zh-TW: gh 新增 agent-task 指令組，在終端機裡派工給程式碼代理
title.en: gh adds an agent-task command group to hand code work to the coding agent from your terminal

body.zh-TW:
剩一段程式碼想整理，你正忙著別的事，於是把它交給 GitHub 的 coding agent（程式碼代理，替你動手改程式的自動助手）——gh 新增的 `agent-task` 指令組，就是在終端機裡派工與追蹤的工具。

```
gh agent-task create "refactor the codebase"   # 派一件工作出去
gh agent-task list                             # 列出你所有任務
gh agent-task view 1234                        # 看某一件的細節
gh agent-task view 1234 --log --follow         # 邊跑邊看
```

最後那個寫法會即時印出執行紀錄（log，程式跑的時候一行一行留下的文字）。同一組指令另外給了三個順手的別名，`gh agent-tasks`、`gh agent`、`gh agents` 打起來都通。⟦一個人有本名，也有幾個熟人喊的小名，喊哪一個，到場的都是同一位。⟧這組指令還在預覽階段，用法可能說改就改，不會事先通知。
body.en:
You've got a chunk of code that needs cleaning up but you're busy with something else, so you hand it to GitHub's coding agent — an automated assistant that edits code for you. gh's new `agent-task` command group is how you dispatch and track that work right from the terminal.

```
gh agent-task create "refactor the codebase"   # send off a task
gh agent-task list                             # list all your tasks
gh agent-task view 1234                        # see details on one
gh agent-task view 1234 --log --follow         # watch it run live
```

That last form streams the log in real time as the task runs. The same command group ships with three handy aliases — `gh agent-tasks`, `gh agent`, and `gh agents` all work the same way. ⟦You go by your given name, but the people who know you well call you by a nickname too — whichever one gets used, it's still you who shows up.⟧ The command group is still in preview, so its behavior can change without notice.
